target_customer: Companies with in-person field sales teams in retail, home improvement, door-to-door, alarm systems and roofing
problem: Field reps are not recorded like phone reps, so managers cannot coach most conversations. COACH records meetings from the phone and gives each rep feedback after every conversation.
business_model: B2B SaaS for sales teams, sold by demo; pricing not published
product_category: AI sales coaching for in-person sales

founders.name: Mathieu Perez
previous_startups: Alsace Test, field sales company, co-founder
founders.background_notes: YC page says Alsace Test reached 3.5M euros revenue in 14 months and that he is a former professional goalkeeper (Atletico Madrid, Racing Club de Strasbourg).

founders.name: Thomas Perez
previous_startups: Alsace Test, field sales company, co-founder
founders.background_notes: Former football player including the University of Alabama per the YC page. A search summary describes the founders as two brothers and a best friend.

founders.name: Nicolas Sebag
founders.background_notes: About 10 years building software in hospitality, aeronautics and healthcare per the YC page; employers not named.

competitors.name: Rilla (RillaVoice)
competitors.what: Records and analyzes in-person sales conversations with AI coaching
competitors.traction_then: Presented AI coaching at Dreamforce in Oct 2025

technical_complexity.rationale: Phone recording, speech transcription and LLM feedback with skill tracking. Mostly standard engineering on top of foundation models.

defensibility.rationale: Aggregated field conversation data and coaching playbooks per customer help, but Rilla and Quantified already sell in-person coaching and the AI layer is copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: In-person coaching vendors existed already in 2025; no response to COACH found.

market_need_then: Field teams lacked recorded conversations to coach from. A 2026 survey cited in a guide found one in three field sales teams had adopted no AI tool, though an AI coach trial cited by Whatfix showed no gain over no coaching.

branding.domain_note: getcoach.com, with a get prefix because the exact name belongs to the fashion brand Coach

identity.voice_and_tone: Bold and direct with uppercase emphasis: 'Train every sales rep like your TOP PERFORMER'

branding.brand_signature: Every rep gets a coach. Your company gets a brain.
branding.community_and_virality: A YC job posting for a brand product designer says the company is going from a French company to a worldwide brand; no community or merch found

brand_strength.rationale: A real word that says what the product does, but it collides with the luxury brand Coach and many AI coaching products, which makes search hard.

outcome_analysis: Active and early with no public outcome. The founders previously built a field sales company, which gives domain access, and company-provided profiles claim about $500K ARR and French enterprise customers. These figures are not independently confirmed, and Rilla and Quantified already compete in in-person coaching.
notes: No funding found; a Dealroom page for a company called Coach lists a $125K seed but does not clearly match, so it is ignored. The roughly $500K ARR and 120% monthly growth appear only in company-supplied profile text. The site's meeting counter renders as 0K+. No outcome news found.
